messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up — Marigold Health just sent a vendor risk form. Main asks: data catalog of PII, embeddings storage location, retention periods, and KMS key provenance. They want evidence by EOD Fri.
Omar (Security): Can you paste the relevant questions? need to map to SOC2 controls and existing artifacts.
Lina (CS): Copied excerpt:
> 1) Do you store PII in embeddings? 2) Where are embeddings persisted (S3 paths/DBs)? 3) Retention TTL by data type. 4) KMS key origin and rotation policy.
Taylor (Legal): Sounds like DPA + vendor checklist overlap. We should avoid sending raw samples with customer PII. Redacted examples or synthetic samples ok.
Sam (Onboarding): I can pull the data inventory CSV and the embedding storage config. Will need access to the infra repo — @Omar can you confirm which repo has the s3 path mapping?
Omar (Security): infra-configs/storage-mapping repo. Look at /services/embeddings/paths.yml. Also we have a doc: "encryption-kms-provenance.md" in security-docs.
Lina (CS): Perfect. Also they asked for retention policy by tenant — we currently have a retention matrix. Sam, can you snapshot the matrix and replace tenant IDs with placeholders?
Sam (Onboarding): Yep. Will generate a redacted matrix. ETA 2pm today.
Taylor (Legal): For KMS key provenance, send the KMIP export + statement that keys are customer-managed for Dedicated/Private customers and AWS- KMS for hosted. Include our BYOK section if applicable.
Omar (Security): Note: for hosted customers we use AWS-managed CMKs; for Dedicated some customers BYOK. I'll draft a short note on rotation schedule and where audit logs live (CloudTrail snippet).
Lina (CS): Evidence checklist I think we should hand back:
``` 
- Redacted data inventory CSV (no tenant IDs)
- Embeddings storage config snippet (paths.yml lines, redacted)
- Retention matrix (PDF)
- KMS provenance note + CloudTrail log snippet (1 sample event)
- SOC2 control mapping doc (highlighted)
```
Sam (Onboarding): I'll upload to the Marigold folder in shared drive and post link. Also will attach the redaction script I use.
Lina (CS): One more ask from Marigold — they want assurance that embeddings can't be reverse-engineered to PII. Can we provide our current mitigation statement?
Omar (Security): Short answer: we document limitations and mitigations (rate limits, prefix-KV caching, tokenization hygiene). I'll draft a 2-paragraph mitigation statement and a pointer to our eval summary.
Taylor (Legal): I'll review the mitigation wording to avoid definitive claims.
Sam (Onboarding): Created the folder and uploaded: https://drive.redwood/marigold-evidence — items: redacted_inventory.csv, retention_matrix.pdf, paths_redacted.yml, redaction_script.sh
evidence-bot: Ticket #CS-4721 created in Zendesk and linked to the Marigold account (priority: high).
Lina (CS): Thanks team. Omar/Taylor — can you both sign off on final bundle by 4:30pm? I'll send the handback email and attach a short cover note explaining redactions and next steps. :thumbsup:
Omar (Security): Will do, aiming for 3:30pm.
Taylor (Legal): I'll review by 4pm.
Lina (CS): Great — closing loop here once sent. If anyone hits blockers, ping me in this thread.
